description: Java class LogView extending TextView, implementing LogNode interface, used for displaying log data in an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and outputs it to the LogView, also passes to next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
